plotEn:
The film chronicles the life of Karimul Haque, popularly known as "Bike Ambulance Dada", who dedicated his life to helping people in remote villages of North Bengal reach hospitals during medical emergencies. Haque began this mission after losing his mother in 1995 due to the unavailability of an ambulance. He later converted his motorcycle into an emergency transport vehicle and spent decades transporting patients free of cost.
Karimul Haque received the Padma Shri in 2017 for his contribution to social service and rural healthcare support.
